---
id: verify-before-claiming
title: Verify a claim against its source before you state it
level: principle
scope: global
kind: pitfall
scenarios: [any]
strength: must
trigger: Stating a number, a result, or that something works
status: verified
seen: 6
first_seen: 2026-06-20
last_seen: 2026-11-01
themes: [accuracy, verification]
---

**Do:** Open the source (table, log, test output) and quote it, rather than recalling it.

**Why:** Plausible but wrong statements cost the person more time than a slower, checked answer.

**Check:** You can point to the file and line each claim came from.
